text:
nora: Heads-up, opening a small PR to add a dedicated capacity quick-checklist: SLA wording, a minimal scalePolicy JSON, and a tenant-selector example for the handbook. Want a quick read before I link it from /handbook/dedicated. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3412

aditya: Nice. Can you paste the minimal JSON you'll include? Makes review faster.

nora: Pasted in the PR description but here it is inline: ```json
{
  "scalePolicy": {
    "minReplicas": 2,
    "maxReplicas": 16,
    "cooldownSeconds": 120,
    "burstCapacity": 4
  },
  "isolation": {
    "type": "reserved_pool",
    "selector": "pool=dedicated-us-west,env=prod"
  },
  "serviceLevelTarget": {
    "p50LatencyMs": 40,
    "p99LatencyMs": 220,
    "availability": "99.9%"
  }
}
```

mira: LGTM overall. Two tiny nits: 1) prefer the phrase "service-level target" instead of "SLA" in user docs to avoid legal wording; 2) call out that `burstCapacity` is measured in GPU units.

aditya: Also add a short CLI snippet for platform teams who use rctl. Something like: `rctl capacity create --name dedicated-us-west --gpus 8 --labels pool=dedicated-us-west,env=prod --scale-policy '{"minReplicas":2,"maxReplicas":16,"cooldownSeconds":120}'`

nora: Added the CLI example to the PR. I also added a one-line footnote: "grace_period_seconds applies only to soft eviction modes and reserved pools."

docs-bot: Linkcheck: 1 broken link detected: /handbook/dedicated/old-autoscale -> suggested replacement /handbook/dedicated/autoscale. Automated suggestion created on branch.

mira: Good catch on the link. Also suggest an inline example mapping `tenant_labels` -> `selector` so readers see the relationship: `labels: {team:search, pool:dedicated-us-west}` -> `selector: pool=dedicated-us-west,team=search`.

nora: Added that mapping and a short troubleshooting bullet: "If pool never scales: verify selector labels, check GPU quota, inspect cooldown and burstCapacity exhaustion."

aditya: Tiny phrasing nit: change "will scale" to "may scale" in the troubleshooting note to avoid promise language.

nora: Updated wording. Ran local linkcheck and docs-bot suggested replacement was applied. CI flagged a lint complaining about inline JSON quoting in the CLI example; switched to a heredoc example in the PR.

mira: Approving from docs side once the heredoc is used. :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck passed after patch, lint passed, static build successful.

lee: Quick ops nit: please also mention that `eviction_policy: hard` ignores `grace_period_seconds` and can preempt immediately; that helps support triage.

nora: Added a one-liner under "Preemption notes": `hard` -> immediate preempt, `soft` -> respects grace period and idle/mem heuristics.

aditya: Approved from platform side.

mira: Approved and will follow-up to add a short crosslink to the autoscale reference page showing metric-based vs cpu-based modes.

docs-bot: Merged PR #3412 into main. Release note: added dedicated capacity quick-checklist, scalePolicy JSON, CLI heredoc example, tenant selector mapping, and preemption note.

nora: Thanks all! :tada: I'll backport a trimmed advisory to the 1.x handbook pages and file a small follow-up to add an example comparing burstCapacity sizes in our loadtests.
